subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
outcomes: Recognise and say twelve space words.
Sort space words: natural objects and things people make.
Give clues about space words and complete sentences with them.

tf.s: A comet is something people make.
tf.why: A comet is a natural object in space.
The Sun is a big, very hot ball that gives light, like other stars.

tf.s: It is safe to look at the Sun.
tf.why: Never look at the Sun because it can hurt your eyes.

tf.s: A rocket is something people make.
tf.why: People build rockets to go into space.

tf.s: The planets in our solar system move around the Moon.
tf.why: The planets move around the Sun.
A spacesuit keeps astronauts safe in space.

tf.s: You can see stars and planets with a telescope.
tf.why: A telescope helps us see things far away in the sky.

tf.s: A space station is a natural object.
Our planet has got a satellite called the Moon.
tf.why: The Moon goes around the Earth.
The Moon goes around the Earth. It is not a planet.

boxes.q: Astronauts fly into space in it. What is it?
boxes.why: A rocket takes astronauts into space.

boxes.q: Which group has only things people make?
boxes.why: People build rockets, satellites and space stations.

boxes.q: Complete: It's fun to watch the sky at night with a ______.
boxes.why: A telescope helps us see the night sky.

boxes.q: Which word means the Sun and all its planets?
boxes.why: The Sun and its planets make the solar system.

boxes.q: Which one is a natural object?
Clue: You can wear it. Which word is it?
Is the Earth a star or a planet?
boxes.why: The Earth is one of the eight planets.

boxes.q: Why must we not look at the Sun?
boxes.why: The Sun is very bright and can hurt our eyes.

boxes.q: Clue: It goes around the Earth and people make it.
boxes.why: People make satellites to go around the Earth.

hunt.q: Astronauts fly into space in it
Use it to look at the night sky
A natural object with a long tail
Astronauts live and work in it
Big, hot ball that gives light

mcq.why: The Moon goes around the Earth, so it is Earth's satellite.
People make satellites to go around the Earth.

mcq.q: Which one do astronauts live and work in, above the Earth?
mcq.why: A space station is a home in space for astronauts.

mcq.q: Which one can hurt your eyes if you look at it?
mcq.why: The Sun is very bright, so never look at it.

mcq.q: Complete: There are eight ______ in our solar system. They move around the Sun.
mcq.why: The eight planets move around the Sun.

o: Astronauts fly into space in it.
It is a very hot star.
mcq.why: A rocket takes astronauts into space.

mcq.q: You want to see a comet at night. What do you need?
mcq.why: A telescope helps you see things far away.

mcq.q: Why is the Sun called a star?
o: It is a big, very hot ball that gives light.
mcq.why: Stars are big, hot balls that give light, like the Sun.

mcq.q: Which word does NOT belong in the group "things people make"?
mcq.why: A comet is natural. People make the other three.

mcq.q: Is a satellite like a rocket or like a star?
o: like a rocket, because people make it
like a star, because it gives light
like a star, because it is very hot
like a star, because it is natural
mcq.why: People make satellites, just like rockets.
